description: This file contains the implementation of the CountryService interface, providing methods to retrieve and manage country data, including caching mechanisms and database interactions. It is part of the core business logic of the application.

classes.name: CountryServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CountryService that handles country data operations including retrieval, addition of descriptions, and caching.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country by its ISO code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a country and updates the entity.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of ISO codes to Country objects for a given language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries matching specified ISO codes for a given language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries for a given language, utilizing caching.
